def oracle(a):
    import itertools
    from scipy.optimize import lsq_linear
    (X, y, r, b, l) = [a[k] for k in ('X', 'y', 'ridge', 'box', 'l0_penalty')]
    p = X.shape[1]
    A = np.vstack((X, np.sqrt(r) * np.eye(p)))
    d = np.r_[y, np.zeros(p)]
    lower = upper = np.inf
    for mask in itertools.product((False, True), repeat=p):
        lim = np.where(mask, b, min(b, 1e-09))
        z = np.clip(lsq_linear(A, d, bounds=(-lim, lim), tol=1e-13).x, -lim, lim)
        res = A @ z - d
        g = A.T @ res
        loss = 0.5 * (res @ res)
        lower = min(lower, loss - g @ z - abs(g) @ lim + l * sum(mask))
        upper = min(upper, loss + l * np.count_nonzero(abs(z) > 1e-09))
    return (lower, upper)
